I needed a place to store notes, documents, tables of info, and links to admin stuff, but wasn't sure what would work best.

A few years back I thought I could install Wordpress on my Cacti server and use it for a few notes. It has worked out quite nicely and it's super easy to add walls of txt.

Since this is only on my internal network, and on my private apache server, I can lock it down however I want. It's worked well.

Not only has it been easy to input info, it's easy to search, file by category, and extract the info when I need it.

The mountains on either side of that arid region prevent the humid air from either side from reaching it.

"Sierras to the left of me,

Rockies to the right.

Here I am,

stuck in the middle with you."

Most of the southwest part of the United States lies on the side of the mountains that is blocked from most of the wind--this is called the leeward side. The mountains go up so high that there is a large drop in temperature, which creates more rain and snow on the side of the mountains that receive the most wind. This takes that water out of the air once it gets over the mountains, and it is not available to reload and drop out of the sky again in the form of rain or snow until it has traveled to an area that is far enough away from the mountains. We call the area that is far enough away "The Great Plains"
